breakdown.description: The name-consistency check mixes the `Mg_Ga` charge-state group with a Ga-vacancy reference entry.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly checks defect_name_consistency only across the Mg_Ga charge-state group (charge states -2, -1, 0, +1) without mixing in any Ga-vacancy reference entry. The specification explicitly states 'Do not attempt to load or include any Ga-vacancy reference entry because no directory or files are specified for it,' and the implementation only creates defect entries for the four Mg_Ga charge-state directories. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which only uses the Mg_Ga substitution entries for the consistency check.
